items.title: 8.1.5 Advanced Information Retrieval Techniques (search engines, keywords, Boolean operators, advanced search features)

source_refs.note: Topic 8.1.5 with the class activity and Did You Know (PDF 197-198, printed 194-195). One example prints 'a student in wants'. MCQ 2 is answered (c); the key gives (a). Short question 5 is answered. Recorded.

items: Effective search queries: be specific; 'traditional Pakistani recipes' gives better results than 'recipes'.
Effective keywords: use the most important words of the topic; 'organic farming' rather than just 'farming'.
Boolean operators: AND includes both terms (agriculture AND irrigation), OR includes either (crops OR vegetables), NOT excludes a term (farming NOT pesticides).
Advanced search features: filter by date, location and more; for the latest news on Pakistan's education policy, limit results to the past year.

blocks.text: More than half of the world's population uses the internet, so researching well online is a powerful skill (Did You Know).
